$comment: Grand Exchange bot life (plugins/bots/ge/GeHub.PlayerBots.js). Counts are how many bots of each role stand around the GE bank booths. Teleporters arrive at the GE teleport landing, bank, step away and teleport out (then despawn). Turn things down here: counts, teleporters.everySeconds / maxActive, chatter.chancePerMinute, social.groups. Set enabled false to switch it all off.
$extraBooths: The GE's bank booth rows (west side x 3162, east side x 3167), added to whatever is found; out is the direction players stand. A booth whose standing tile is blocked is skipped.

layout.$skillers: skillers take the closest tiles to the bank: free booth fronts first (keepBoothFrontsFree of all fronts stay open for real players), then the tiles around the bankers, sharing a tile only when nothing close is left
layout.$distances: socialDistance and bonfireDistance are tiles from the nearest bank booth, on the plaza side

pets.$comment: Chance a GE bot (chance) or a teleporting visitor (teleporterChance) has a skilling or boss pet following it, from the Pets plugin list; excludePattern leaves out pets by name.

outfitMinCombat.$comment: boss gear only on bots this combat level or higher, mid gear (rune/dragon/barrows) from midgear up; low gear (bronze to adamant) only up to lowMaxCombat

gamble.$comment: Each gambling host has its own timer (hosts.dice / hosts.flowers everySeconds); when it's up and no bot is already at that host, a random GE bot or visitor walks over and plays a round in chat, then goes back. Maxed bots in boss gear (richest) bet 1b and are richWeight times as likely to be picked; only they bet platinum tokens (tokenChance). The rest bet coins by combat band. Testing: 10 s each; normal was 30-300. enabled false (here or per host) switches it off.
gamble.$standSide: standSide is [dx, dy] from the host: [-1, 0] west, [1, 0] east, [0, 1] north, [0, -1] south
